name: Auto-Tune
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Pro-grade vocal pitch correction. YIN pitch detector + TD-PSOLA shifter + 16th-order LPC formant preservation with bandwidth expansion + Lanczos-3 windowed-sinc interpolation + 100 ms input lookahead + GCI grain snapping + vibrato preservation + adaptive retune + transient bypass. Preset slider (0=Custom · 1=Natural · 2=Pop · 3=Hard/Snap · 4=Cher · 5=Country · 6=Subtle) selects voicings; when 1-6, it overrides Retune/Humanize/Strength/Formant — Key, Scale and Mix stay user-set. Designed for offline / batch vocal processing; ~100 ms latency in exchange for quality.
